```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
raw <- read.csv("asimplied.csv", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dep <- format(strptime(raw$SOBT, "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M"), "%H%M")
corpus <- data.frame(flight = raw[["Flight Designator"]],
                     n      = raw[["S.no"]],
                     route  = raw[["Routing"]],
                     dest   = raw[["dest_iata"]],
                     cap    = raw[["Seats"]],
                     dep    = dep,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
corpus <- corpus[order(corpus$n), ]

# --- Model M1 parameters (first model column of seats.xlsx) ---
mean_before <- 150   # minutes before departure (mean entry)
sigma       <- 30    # minutes (standard deviation)
LF          <- 1     # load factor for M1

hhmm <- function(m) {            # minutes-of-day (any integer) -> "HHMM", wrapped to 24h
  m <- ((round(m) %% 1440) + 1440) %% 1440
  sprintf("%02d%02d", m %/% 60L, m %% 60L)
}
```

```{r curves, results='asis'}
legend_plain <- function() {
  cat("\\par\\vspace{3pt}{\\centering\\scriptsize ")
  cat("\\textcolor{black}{\\rule[0.35ex]{2.6ex}{1.1pt}}\\,M1 entry rate (pax / 10 min)\\quad{}")
  cat("\\tikz[baseline]{\\draw[dashed,line width=0.7pt] (0,0.5ex) -- (2.6ex,0.5ex);}\\,mean $\\mu$")
  cat("\\par}\n")
}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(corpus))) {
  f    <- corpus$flight[i]
  rt   <- corpus$route[i]
  cap  <- corpus$cap[i]
  dch  <- corpus$dep[i]
  depm <- as.integer(substr(dch, 1, 2)) * 60L + as.integer(substr(dch, 3, 4))
  mu   <- depm - mean_before          # mean entry, minutes of day (may be negative = prior day)
  pax  <- round(LF * cap)
  A    <- pax * 10 / (sigma * sqrt(2 * pi))   # peak height, pax per 10 min
  lo   <- mu - 95; hi <- mu + 95
  h1   <- ceiling(lo / 60); h2 <- floor(hi / 60)
  ticks   <- seq(h1 * 60L, h2 * 60L, by = 60L)
  tickpos <- paste(ticks, collapse = ",")
  ticklab <- paste(vapply(ticks, hhmm, ""), collapse = ",")
  ymax <- 100                          # fixed y-axis scale across all flights

  cat("\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\begin{tikzpicture}\n")
  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    "\\begin{axis}[\n",
    "  width=12.5cm, height=8cm,\n",
    "  axis lines=left,\n",
    "  x axis line style={-{Latex[length=2.6mm]}},\n",
    "  y axis line style={-{Latex[length=2.6mm]}},\n",
    "  xmin=%f, xmax=%f, ymin=0, ymax=%f,\n",
    "  xtick={%s}, xticklabels={%s},\n",
    "  ytick distance=10,\n",
    "  tick style={black},\n",
    "  x tick label style={font=\\footnotesize}, y tick label style={font=\\footnotesize},\n",
    "  clip=false\n",
    "]\n"),
    lo, hi, ymax, tickpos, ticklab))
  cat(sprintf(
    "\\addplot[line width=1pt, domain=%f:%f, samples=100, smooth]{ %f*exp(-(x-(%f))^2/%f) };\n",
    lo, hi, A, mu, 2 * sigma^2))
  cat(sprintf("\\draw[dashed, line width=0.7pt] (axis cs:%f,0) -- (axis cs:%f,%f);\n",
              mu, mu, A))
  cat(sprintf("\\node[below=11pt, font=\\footnotesize] at (axis cs:%f,0) {$\\mu=%s$};\n",
              mu, hhmm(mu)))
  cat("\\end{axis}\n\\end{tikzpicture}\n")
  legend_plain()
  cat(sprintf(paste0("\\caption{Flight %s (%s), dep %s. Model M1 entry-time distribution: ",
                     "Normal, mean 150 min before departure ($\\mu=%s$), SD 30 min; ",
                     "area $=%d$ pax (LF $=1$).}\n"),
              f, rt, dch, hhmm(mu), pax))
  cat("\\end{figure}\n\\clearpage\n")
}
```
